headline: Japan Mandates Increased Crypto Tax Audits Following $24.5 Million Under-Reporting
summary: Japan's tax authorities announced plans to intensify on-site audits of cryptocurrency traders after finding 3.7 billion yen ($24.5 million) in unreported crypto income during recent reviews.
why: Japan maintains strict tax rules and regulatory enforcement oversight on digital asset earnings.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Japanese tax officials announced increased crypto trader audits after detecting hidden income.
